reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Military commissioned officer authority to administer oaths and depositions
headings.reviewNote: Empowers armed forces commissioned officers to administer oaths, depositions, and affidavits for military personnel.

headings.title: Officer certificate details, military branch, and security omissions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies officer certificate contents and validates omissions of serial number or location for security reasons.

headings.title: Statutory military jurat form for oaths and depositions
headings.reviewNote: Sets standard statutory jurat form for armed forces oaths, depositions, and affidavits.

headings.title: Validation of prior military oaths and non-conforming depositions
headings.reviewNote: Validates all prior military oaths, affidavits, and depositions complying with section from and after June 12, 1991.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections and embedded military jurat form on commissioned officer oaths/depositions (excluding warrant officers), security omissions, and June 12, 1991 validation.

headings.title: Court appointment of special commissioner to take depositions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court appointment of a disinterested attorney of record as special commissioner to take depositions.

headings.title: Special commissioner subpoena enforcement and witness attachment powers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes special commissioner to compel witness attendance by attachment under previously served subpoenas.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on court appointment of disinterested attorney special commissioners for depositions and enforcement of previously served subpoenas.

headings.title: General authority and powers of deposition special commissioners
headings.reviewNote: Confers on special commissioners all legal powers and duties of officers authorized to take depositions.

headings.title: Special commissioner power to rule on evidentiary objections
headings.reviewNote: Empowers special commissioner to hear and determine all evidentiary objections as a trial court would.

headings.title: Reporting sustained evidentiary objections to the court
headings.reviewNote: Entitles aggrieved parties to have sustained objections reported by special commissioner to the court.

headings.title: Judicial review and orders affirming or reversing commissioner rulings
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to forthwith pass upon reported rulings and order excluded evidence admitted if reversed.

headings.title: Adjournment and enforcement of witness answers following judicial reversal
headings.reviewNote: Directs commissioner to adjourn proceedings and enforce witness attendance to answer questions upon court reversal.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 5 subsections on special commissioner deposition powers, evidentiary rulings, reporting sustained objections, judicial review, and adjournment/enforcement.

headings.title: Subpoena and witness compulsion powers for deposition officers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes deposition officers to issue subpoenas and compel witness attendance under court of record penalties.

headings.title: Imprisonment of refusing witnesses and habeas corpus costs
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes committing refusing witnesses to prison without bail, awarding costs and attorney fees upon habeas discharge.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on deposition officer subpoena/compulsion powers and imprisonment of refusing witnesses with habeas corpus costs and attorney fees.

headings.title: Essential witness felony depositions upon court finding
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes prosecutor to take depositions of essential eyewitnesses to felonies under court protective orders.

headings.title: Confrontation rights, defendant attendance, and travel expense taxation
headings.reviewNote: Requires court orders protecting confrontation rights, discovery compliance, and taxing defendant travel costs.

headings.title: Trial use of essential witness depositions and witness unavailability
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes trial use of essential witness videotaped depositions when witness refuses to testify or fails to attend.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections on essential witness felony depositions (excluding accused and spouse), confrontation/discovery protections, and trial use.

headings.title: Admissibility requirements for recorded statements of child or vulnerable person
headings.reviewNote: Establishes reliability standards for admitting recorded statements of children under 18 or vulnerable persons in sex/assault crimes.

headings.title: Prerequisites for recorded statement when child or vulnerable person does not testify
headings.reviewNote: Conditions admissibility of recorded statement on qualification under section 491.075 if the child or vulnerable person does not testify at the proceeding.

headings.title: Cumulative admissibility when child or vulnerable person testifies
headings.reviewNote: Makes an admissible recorded statement admissible in addition to live testimony of the child or vulnerable person whether or not duplicative.

headings.title: Definition of nonverbal statements including physical demonstrations
headings.reviewNote: Defines nonverbal statement to include actions, facial expressions, and visual aid demonstrations.

headings.title: Definition of vulnerable person lacking mental capacity
headings.reviewNote: Defines vulnerable person as one with impaired intelligence or psychiatric disorder lacking capacity to consent.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 5 subsections and effective-date note (Effective 8-28-26); aligned subsections 2–3 titles to "child or vulnerable person" instead of "victim".

headings.title: Trial use of depositions as testimony in open court
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes reading conforming depositions in evidence as if witnesses were present and testifying in open court.

headings.title: Circumstances establishing witness unavailability for reading depositions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies grounds for establishing unavailability, including death, sickness, nonresidence, distance, or official duties.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections and Adkison v. Hannah (475 S.W.2d 39) annotation on reading depositions in evidence and six grounds of witness unavailability.

headings.title: Deposition costs and expenses awarded as judgment for requesting party
headings.reviewNote: Provides that court reporter fees and deposition expenses are awarded as judgments, limiting copies to one per party.

headings.title: Court limitations on certified deposition costs and reasonableness factors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to limit certified deposition costs based on relevance, taking time, and community reporter rates.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections, footnote (*section 514.460 transferred to 488.432 in 2000), and Burwick v. Wood (959 S.W.2d 951) annotation on deposition cost judgments and limits.
